verdict.rationale: Brave publishes an official MCP server (github.com/brave/brave-search-mcp-server), confirmed by a probe. It exposes web, local, image, video and news search, LLM context and summarization tools, and Brave's own guides cover setup with the Claude desktop app and with Claude Cowork on Amazon Bedrock. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of using the MCP server in practice.
